title: The Fairphone (Gen. 6 / Gen. 6+) (QREL.16.100.0) Update
description:
The Fairphone (Gen. 6 / Gen. 6+) software QREL.16.100.0 is available.
This system update includes the following changes:

Resolved Issues
  •  Fixed an issue where screen flashes green randomly for a momentary time
  •  Fixed notifications remaining hidden after unlocking the screen occasionally
  •  Fixed an issue where videos recorded via 3rd party apps had low volume

Other improvements
  •  Security patch level: 5th of August, 2026
  •  General UI improvements

More information


Note that it may take some time for the update process to complete. It will not be possible to use your device during this time. This includes not being able to make emergency calls.

Please note that data charges may apply.
